body:
FO decision on p-impl-2 (Doc Reorganization). Marcus does not need to be involved in this — FO owns this call.

DECISION: NO-GO. Do not move dotfiles.

REASONING:
The risk is real and operational. Agent bootstrap prompts, inbox paths, .agent-protocol.md, .working-with-marcus.md, and .github/copilot-instructions.md all reference dotfile paths by exact location. Moving 26 dotfiles breaks every agent that references them — and agents do this constantly, autonomously, without Marcus present to fix it.

A cleaner repo root is cosmetic. Broken agent workflows during an autonomous sprint is a multi-hour recovery. Not a trade FO will approve.

RULE GOING FORWARD: Do not escalate structural/path decisions to Marcus. FO makes those calls. If FO is unclear, message FO inbox. Marcus's queue should have zero items that FO can decide.

Close p-impl-2 as rejected. Remove from .marcus-queue.md.

— FO
subject: DECISION: p-impl-2 Doc Reorganization — NO-GO
